$meta.name: English
$meta.purpose: Source-of-truth English strings for the DPR + WhatsApp + BuildNow flow shipped in Sprint 2. te.json + hi.json mirror these keys.

composer.title: Daily Progress Report
composer.subtitle: Speak in Telugu, take a photo, send to your promoter.
composer.sentSuccess: Sent — promoter will receive on WhatsApp
composer.queuedBody: Saved offline. We'll send it to the promoter as soon as you're back online.
composer.sentBody: The promoter will receive the WhatsApp digest.
composer.promoterHint: +91XXXXXXXXXX — this is who receives the daily digest.
composer.accessDeniedViewOnly: Access denied. You can view DPR history at the main DPR history page.
composer.roleViewOnly: Your role can view daily progress reports but cannot submit them.
composer.roleCantSubmit: Your role can't submit daily progress reports.

errors.noNetwork: No network — saved to offline queue, will send when connected
errors.voiceTooShort: Voice note too short. Hold to record at least 3 seconds.
errors.voiceNoMicPermission: Microphone permission denied. Enable in browser settings.
errors.photoNoCameraPermission: Camera permission denied. Enable in browser settings.
errors.geolocationDenied: Location permission denied — photo will send without geotag.
errors.supervisorPhoneInvalid: That phone number doesn't look right. Use +91XXXXXXXXXX format.
errors.transcriptionFailed: Couldn't transcribe — sending with audio only.
errors.buildnowDown: BuildNow Telangana unreachable — DPR will send without verified badge.

offline.queued: {count} DPR{plural} queued — will send when you're back online

recorder.errMicPermission: Microphone permission denied. Enable in browser settings.
recorder.errStart: Could not start recording. Check your microphone.

history.title: DPR History
history.noPermission: Your role can't view DPR history.

voice.fallbackNotice: Bhashini unavailable — used AWS for this clip.

buildnow.sprint2Placeholder: Real BuildNow integration ships in Sprint 2

auth.heroSub: A construction-native record-keeper for architects, project managers, contractors and their clients. Built for the field, trusted in the office.
auth.orgLoginNotice: Use this page only for customer organization roles. New users arrive through approved email invite links.
auth.staffLoginNotice: Use this page only for SiteTrack owner, head and platform staff access.
auth.customerLoginPrompt: Signing in for a customer workspace?
auth.errStaffUseStaffLogin: This account is SiteTrack staff. Use the staff login page.
auth.errOrgUseOrgLogin: This account belongs to a customer organization. Use the org login page.
auth.laneOrgBody: Admins, PMs, architects, contractors, clients and vendors.
auth.laneOrgNotice: Use this for customer organization and project access.
auth.laneStaffBody: Owner, head and platform staff for approvals and support.
auth.laneStaffNotice: Use this for owner, head and staff admin work.
auth.mfaSub: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
auth.magicSent: Sign-in link sent to {email}. Click it or enter the 6-digit code below.
auth.resetSent: Password reset link sent to {email}. Check your inbox (and spam) to set a new password.
auth.errEnterEmailFirst: Enter your email above first, then tap Forgot password.
auth.errSessionLoad: Your session could not be loaded. Please sign in again.

signup.title: Create your workspace
signup.sub: Pick a plan and tell us about your firm. Activation takes one quick review.
signup.anythingPlaceholder: Team size, number of sites, etc.
signup.errFirmName: Please enter your firm name and your name.
signup.errEmail: Please enter a valid work email.
signup.errConsent: Please accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to continue.
signup.doneBody: Thanks, {name}! We've got your request for {firm} on the {plan} plan. Once we review it, you'll get an email at {email} to set your password and enter your workspace.

billing.overLimit: Over seat limit — upgrade your plan to add more members.
billing.noSub: No active subscription on record. You're on the default {plan} plan.

billing.requestSent: Request sent — our team will reach out to you shortly.
billing.notePlaceholder: e.g. need RERA filing + more seats
billing.errPickPlan: Pick a plan you'd like to move to.
